## What changed and why?

Describe the problem and the result of this change. Link any related issue.

## Testing

List the checks you ran and their results. For hardware tests, include the board, firmware revision and connected peripherals. Say what remains untested.

## Screenshots

For UI changes, add screenshots if available. Remove this section if it does not apply.

## Before submitting

- [ ] I kept the change focused and updated relevant documentation.
- [ ] I added or updated tests where useful and reported the checks I ran.
- [ ] I removed secrets and private data from code, logs and attachments.
- [ ] I preserved third-party notices and documented any new dependencies.
